Book buyers

Your readers belong to the retailer

When someone buys Confidence Is an Inside Job from a bookshop, you never get their email. The people most moved by your message leave no trace you can follow up on.

Podcast and IG

Fans with no way onto your list

A listener who loves the show but isn’t ready for 1:1 coaching can buy your book, but there is no free class or lead magnet that gets them onto your list. So most of them just keep listening.

Free call

Your calendar takes everyone

An open free call means your time goes to whoever books first, ready or not. There is nothing warming people up or filtering them before they reach you.

Your message already reaches a lot of women. What’s missing is the step that turns that reach into a list, a first purchase and booked calls with the right people.

My recommendation

A free confidence masterclass, with your book as the first thing they buy

You already have a low-ticket product: your book. So the class is free, the book bundle becomes the thank-you page upsell, and the application sits on the replay page.

Sound familiar?

It’s not that you lack talent. It’s the voice in your head.

  • You talk yourself out of the opportunity before anyone else gets the chance to.
  • You scroll, compare, and leave feeling like everyone else is further ahead.
  • You say yes to everyone, then wonder why there’s nothing left for you.
  • You know what you want to do next, but keep waiting until you feel “ready”.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why confidence is an inside job

Why more achievements and more approval never quite fill the gap, and where real confidence comes from.

How to spot the self-doubt script

The three stories that keep capable women playing small, and how to catch them in the moment.

The comparison reset

A simple way to step out of the scroll-and-compare loop and back into your own lane.

Saying no without the guilt

How to set boundaries that protect your energy without feeling like you’re letting people down.

Your first brave step this week

Pick one move you’ve been putting off and leave with a plan to take it in the next seven days.
